/home/eaziel/.local/share/isaacsim-launc.content:
# Enter the shared Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab environment.

# 清除当前终端继承的Conda激活状态，再进入独立venv。
if declare -F conda >/dev/null; then
    while [[ -n "${CONDA_PREFIX:-}" ]]; do
        conda deactivate || return 1
    done
fi

export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$HOME/my_venvs/lab3_sim62/.venv"
if [[ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]]; then
    printf 'venv activation script not found: %s\n' "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" >&2
    return 1
fi
source "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" || return 1
cd "$HOME/IsaacLab-main" || return 1

# Start Isaac Sim and keep the configured interactive shell afterward.

# 保留用户的终端设置；进入新环境后不再新开或替换shell。
[[ ! -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ]] || source "$HOME/.bashrc"
source "$HOME/.local/share/isaacsim-launcher/env.sh" || return 1

history -s 'isaacsim isaacsim.exp.full'
isaacsim isaacsim.exp.full || printf '\nIsaac Sim exited with status %s. The terminal remains available.\n' "$?"
